body:
The document provides an earnings calendar from Zacks Investment Research, detailing various companies' earnings estimates, reported results, surprises, and percentage changes. Notable companies include Home Depot, Bank of Montreal, and Intuit, with several reporting positive surprises. The calendar includes a mix of companies across different sectors, indicating their market capitalization and performance metrics.
